check: The patch must contain a diff that modifies at least one file other than the test file containing the failing assertion.
description: Ensures the fix is applied to the source code, not the test itself.

check: The patch must not contain any lines that modify the assertion logic or expected values within the failing test file.
description: Verifies that the test assertion remains unchanged as per the constraint.

check: After applying the patch, the previously failing unit test must pass when executed.
description: Confirms that the fix actually resolves the failure.

check: After applying the patch, all other existing unit tests in the project must continue to pass.
description: Ensures the fix does not introduce new failures in other parts of the codebase.
